items.title: El Niño then and now
items.summary: El Niño is part of a natural climate pattern that occurs roughly every two to seven years, bringing warmer-than-normal water to parts of the equatorial Pacific. The most recent very strong El Niño events, in 1997–98 and 2015–16, upended weather patterns. Impacts spanned the planet, from fires in Indonesia and the Amazon to crop failures due to drought in southern Africa to heavy rain and coastal flooding in Southern California. The current El Niño rivals these past heavyweights.

Catch up fast: Diesel prices have climbed to record highs since the U.S. war with Iran began in March, rising faster than gasoline amid global oil supply disruptions . Diesel averaged $6.31 a gallon Thursday, up 74% from a year ago, according to AAA . Regular gasoline averaged $4.27, up 39%. The big picture: Gasoline gets the attention, but diesel is the workhorse of the American economy. The Lakers cut Dalton Knecht and kept Bronny James, leaving critics to question whether the final roster spot was wasted. The central question sounds simple. Is a bench spot wasted on a player who rarely plays? The honest answer truly depends on money, fit, development, and what a team needs most over a long season. The Lakers started Monday with 16 players and needed 15 by 5 p.m. Eastern. They waived former first-round pick Dalton Knecht to meet the limit. Bronny James kept his roster spot after the cut. Cuts like this are rarely simple. Teams weigh money, fit, and long-term potential all at once. A roster spot at the end of the bench carries far more thought than most fans ever realize.

Can Green Bay win another game with just four interior defensive linemen? Detroit will be a big test Most NFL teams still match their defensive personnel to what opposing offenses throw out there, and the Green Bay Packers are no different. In general, defenses want to play as many cornerbacks and nickelbacks as the opposing offense has receivers. So when offenses are in 11 personnel (three receivers, one back and one tight end) sets, defenses tend to play Nickel — which allows for a slot defender to "match" a slot receiver on the field. So far in 2026, the Packers have played 291 of their 292 snaps when they've faced 11 personnel offenses in Nickel (or Dime) sets — 99.7 percent.

Letter: Emma Sainsbury questions whether government policy takes sufficient account of people whose caring responsibilities shape their finances and ability to keep a home For 13 years, I have cared for my lovely 101-year-old adoptive mum who requires round-the-clock care. I feel blessed to care for her and have no regrets. But love does not pay the bills. Carer’s allowance is £86.45 a week for 2026-27. Spread across 168 hours, that is roughly 51p an hour.
